name: lappy
description: Framework Laptop 13, AMD Ryzen 7 7840U, Radeon 780M iGPU (Vulkan), 62 GB shared LPDDR5
notes: Calibrated 2026-08-17/18 against measured models on this exact box.
On this measured box, decode tracked active parameter traffic more closely than total parameters. That is consistent with memory-traffic pressure, but does not prove a bottleneck.
Observed: 30B MoE (~3B active) 24.8 tok/s > 8B dense 14.6 > 24B dense 4.5 > 27B dense 3.5.

fast_chat.why: comfortable human reading is ~5-6 tok/s; 10 gives headroom. TTFT is what makes it FEEL fast.

interactive_coding.why: you skim code faster than prose

uncensored.why: 3 mundane prompts aligned models often refuse; >0 means it will fight you on ordinary editorial work

structured_output.why: quantization degrades JSON validity before prose. Below ~3/4 valid, a pipeline spends more time retrying than working; a healthy instruct model at a healthy quant clears this easily, so failing it is a damage signal, not a taste call.

instruction_precision.why: verifiable constraints (exact envelope, line rules, word budgets) graded by code. Persistent misses mean every prompt needs a retry wrapper.

tool_calling.why: a gate has to be reachable by the battery that feeds it. Three families at -k 3 is nine trials, and nine perfect trials pin the rate no tighter than [0.70, 1.00] -- so 0.70 is the strictest bar this sample can clear, and a stricter one would leave the need permanently undecided rather than strict. This separates a model whose tool calls land from one whose do not; it cannot separate 90% from 95%, and does not pretend to. Raise -k to raise the bar

tool_restraint.why: same arithmetic: three irrelevance specs at -k 3 is nine trials. Firing a tool on a question no tool can answer burns a turn and drags an agent loop off course, so the bar should be as high as the evidence supports and no higher

unattended_agentic.why: Longer agent histories increase repeated prompt processing. This gate measures observed prefill rather than assuming it dominates every loop.

always_on_capable.why: leaves room for an embedding model plus a browser in 62 GB

quality.why: Multiple independent signals -- a single metric misses cases. A looping table scored dup_paragraph_ratio 0.0 while dup_line_ratio was 0.91 and gzip CR 9.2. Gopher corpus thresholds (dup_line 0.30, top_4gram 0.16) are reused; gzip CR anchors: human prose ~2.28, model output 2.36-2.72, so >4.0 is plainly degenerate. Truncation matters because ~92% of truncations are repetition loops.
